title: Composition of polynomial-time maps
statement: Given polynomial-time maps $f$ and $g$ on binary strings, their composition is the map that first applies $f$ and then applies $g$; it is equipped with a polynomial-time computation certificate.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a polynomial-time map on binary strings.
